name: A mini-moon: 2024 PT5
description: The 10 m asteroid 2024 PT5 drifted past the Earth slowly enough that from 29 September to 25 November 2024 it was bound to it: a temporary second moon. It never went round: the Sun's pull, stronger than the Earth's out there at 4 million km, let it go again. Position and velocity on 30 October 2024 from JPL Horizons; the capture and release dates here match JPL's to within a day.
